content: The vcpkg x-gha GitHub Actions Cache binary-caching backend was removed (tracked in microsoft/vcpkg-tool PR #1662, ~April 2025) because GitHub's internal cache API was never meant to be consumed that way. Microsoft's official binary-caching-github-actions-cache tutorial now carries a deprecation notice. Current recommendation: NuGet-based binary caching (GitHub Packages NuGet feed) via VCPKG_BINARY_SOURCES, or the community-run lukka/run-vcpkg action which manages actions/cache directly instead of x-gha.
